name: Shobai
title: Levitical Gatekeeper After the Exile
summary: Shobai was a Levite who belonged to the gatekeepers (doorkeepers) of the temple. He is mentioned among those who returned from the Babylonian exile and resumed service at the temple in Jerusalem. His descendants were among the faithful servants who helped restore temple worship.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Gatekeepers Who Returned
keyEvents.description: Shobai's descendants are mentioned among the gatekeepers who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel and Jeshua. They were among those who resumed temple service in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The Gatekeepers in Nehemiah's List
keyEvents.description: Shobai's descendants are again listed among the gatekeepers in Nehemiah's register of those who returned from exile.

keyEvents.title: Service at the Gates of Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Shobai's descendants served as gatekeepers at the storehouses by the gates and kept watch at the temple in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

keyEvents.title: The Gatekeepers in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The Shobal family is mentioned among the Levitical gatekeepers who were responsible for guarding the entrances to the Lord's house.
